description_en: Modifies the configuration of an enterprise-level snapshot policy
description_zh: 调用UpdateEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy修改企业级快照策略配置
kebab_example: aliyun ebs update-enterprise-snapshot-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id esp-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the policy to modify
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the snapshot policy. Valid values:

ENABLED
DISABLED
parameters.help_zh:
快照策略状态。取值范围：

ENABLED
DISABLED
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en: The description of the snapshot policy
parameters.name: desc

fields.help_en:
The execution cycle and time of the policy. A cron expression is used.

For example, `0 0 4 1/1 * ?` specifies that the snapshot operation is performed at 04:00 every day, starting from the first day of each month
fields.help_zh:
策略执行的周期和时间。使用cron表达式。

例如：`0 0 4 1/1 * ?`表示从每月第一天上午4时开始，每天的上午4时执行快照操作
fields.name: cron_expression

fields.help_en: The number of snapshots to retain. Valid values: 1 to 256
fields.name: number

fields.help_en: The time interval of the retention rule. The unit is specified by the TimeUnit parameter. The value must be greater than 1
fields.help_zh: 保留规则的时间间隔，单位通过参数TimeUnit指定,取值范围大于 1
fields.name: time_interval

fields.help_en:
The unit of the retention time. Valid values:

DAYS
WEEKS
fields.help_zh:
保留时间单位。取值范围：

DAYS
WEEKS
fields.name: time_unit

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable special retention. Valid values:

true
false
fields.help_zh:
是否启用特殊保留。取值范围：

true
false
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en:
The period unit for special retention snapshots. For example, if this parameter is set to WEEKS, the first snapshot of each week is given special retention. The retention duration is determined by the TimeUnit and TimeInterval parameters. Valid values:

WEEKS
MONTHS
YEARS
fields.help_zh:
特殊保留的快照的周期单位，如果配置成WEEKS，则为每周的第一个快照提供特殊保留，保留的时间由TimeUnit，TimeInterval决定。取值范围为：

WEEKS
MONTHS
YEARS
fields.name: special_period_unit

fields.help_en: The time interval of the retention rule. The unit is specified by the TimeUnit parameter. The value must be greater than 1
fields.help_zh: 保留规则的时间间隔，单位通过参数TimeUnit指定,取值范围大于 1
fields.name: time_interval

fields.help_en:
The unit of the retention time for special snapshots. Valid values:

DAYS
WEEKS
fields.help_zh:
特殊快照的保留时间单位。取值范围：

DAYS
WEEKS
fields.name: time_unit

fields.help_en: The list of special retention rules. Multiple rules are supported
fields.help_zh: 特殊保留规则列表，支持多个规则
fields.name: rules

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable cross-region replication. Valid values:

true
false
fields.help_zh:
是否启用跨地域复制。取值范围：

true
false
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The destination region ID for snapshot replication. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354206.html to query the region information of existing asynchronous replication relationships
fields.help_zh: 快照复制目的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354206.html查询存量异步复制关系的地域信息
fields.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The number of days to retain snapshots in the destination region. The value must be greater than 1
fields.help_zh: 目的地快照保留天数。取值范围大于1
fields.name: retain_days

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken value supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable instant access for snapshots. Valid values:

true
false
fields.help_zh:
是否启动快照极速可用。取值范围：

true
false
fields.name: enable_immediate_access
